author: Ya-Marie Sesay
title: Hank's Oyster Bar amongst DC restaurants supporting federal workers amid government shutdown - NewsBreak
text:
By Ya-Marie Sesay ,
2 hours ago
WASHINGTON ( DC News Now ) — With the government shutdown stretching into its first days, many federal workers are finding ways to cope with the stress and uncertainty.
For some, that means gathering with friends and family over food and drinks, especially at restaurants, stepping in to ease the burden.
“We know times are hard for everyone, and at Hanks we always want to be a place where guests feel at home, where you feel supported, and we want to make people smile,” said Erin Lucas, area manager for Hank’s Oyster Bar. “We’re doing everything to make memories, make you smile, ease your stress, and make people feel a little better during these tough times.”
DC landmarks, institutions close less than 24 hours into government shutdown At Hank’s Oyster Bar at The Wharf and Dupont Circle, management said they are committed to supporting government employees during the shutdown. The restaurant is offering “Shutdown specials,” which include all-day happy hour and 20% off lunch and dinner for federal workers who show their government ID.
“It’s a really tough time. People are concerned about money, the holidays are approaching, family is important. Those price breaks ease your stress a little bit,” Lucas said.
Several furloughed government workers took advantage of the restaurant’s specials.
One person who did not want to be identified told DC News Now the uncertainty has been the most difficult part.
“I feel like my head is just spinning right now, not knowing what to expect. Hopefully it’s not too long,” they said. “The biggest impact is going to be the pay, not getting a paycheck. I’ll probably have to rely on savings.”
For Hank’s Oyster Bar, the effort is about more than discounts; it’s about community.
“We’re going to keep the specials going as long as the shutdown goes. Hopefully it won’t be too long, but we’re here to support our community and make people smile,” Lucas said.
Other restaurants across the D.C., Maryland, and Virginia region are also rolling out deals for furloughed employees.
